findings.title: Residual of F-DG1-217: the module lint still crashes with TypeScript 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed' on an arbitrary-extension declaration file (*.d.<ext>.ts, e.g. zz.d.css.ts / zz.d.json.ts). The fix's DECLARATION_FILE = /\.d\.[cm]?ts$/ (apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts:445) does not match these names, so syntaxErrors() still sends them to ts.transpileModule. TypeScript (>= 5.0, allowArbitraryExtensions) treats *.d.<ext>.ts as a declaration file, and the emit throws. The lint fails closed (it throws, so architecture.test.ts goes red and nothing slips through).
findings.reproduction: Candidate sha256:76d8b3049d22d414a4c036bd3dd1af6e0c3609baedb096e2d2ecf4180bf07846, full disposable clone at f27b5a6f. (1) Node v22.22.2 and v24.21.0: copy docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/dg1-r15-dts-probe.test.ts to apps/api/src/ and run `npx vitest run --project unit-node apps/api/src/dg1-r15-dts-probe.test.ts`. 16/17 pass (.d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts are all fine). The edge case plants apps/api/src/modules/transformations/zz-qa-r15-arb.d.css.ts and calls the production moduleViolations('transformations'), which throws 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed'. (2) Node v24.21.0, apps/api of the clone: calling fileViolations('transformations', <MODULES_DIR>/transformations/<name>, deep type import) gives OK (violation reported) for zz.test.d.ts, zz.d.ts, zz.d.mts, zz.d.cts, zz.d.html.mts and zz.d.tsx, and THROW 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed' for zz.d.css.ts and zz.d.json.ts (09-f217-name-variants.log).
findings.expected: Every name that TypeScript treats as a declaration file (ts.isDeclarationFileName semantics, including *.d.<ext>.ts) goes through declarationSyntaxErrors() or is skipped explicitly, so the lint reports a named diagnostic or a boundary violation and never an internal compiler assertion. A self-check pins this, for example by adding zz.d.css.ts to the F-DG1-217 cases in architecture.test.ts.
findings.actual: zz.d.css.ts and zz.d.json.ts under apps/api/src/modules make moduleViolations() throw 'Debug Failure. Output generation failed', with no file name in the message. The real tree has no such file today (real-tree lint = 0 violations), so no current check is red.

history.note: Raised by qa-verifier in DG1 round 15 while independently verifying F-DG1-217. Rated Low and non-mandatory for the same reasons as F-DG1-217. The lint fails closed: it throws and goes red, so nothing passes unchecked. Declaration files emit no runtime code, an arbitrary-extension declaration file inside a backend API module is an unlikely layout, and there is no access-control, integrity, calculation or portability impact. F-DG1-217's own stated reproduction (.d.ts/.d.mts/.d.cts/.test.d.ts) is fixed and verified separately. This is a narrower residual name class. The proposed ID F-DG1-218 is the next free number after 217; the orchestrator may renumber it if another reviewer proposed the same number this round. It does not block DG1 on its own. The orchestrator may route it to a repair or accept it as an observation.
